# Add-ons

**Available since 1.5.0.** The current catalogue contains 631 add-ons (533 PS4 and 98 PS5), with 633 download options across 197 base games. Use matching apps and the PS5 service; a catalogue refresh alone does not add the page to an older app.

Add-ons are downloadable extras for games you already own. Open **Add-ons**, next to **Browse**, or select **Add-ons (count)** on a game's details page. This page is available in the browser, native PS5 app and Orbit Zero, in Store, Crossbar, Cinema and Panorama.

Search by the add-on's name or its base game. Use **Platform**, **Type**, **Source** and **Region** to narrow the results. New additions appear first. An add-on uses its base game's artwork when separate artwork is unavailable.

## Choose the right content

- **Expansion** adds a separate campaign or substantial extra content.
- **Content pack** adds items, characters, missions or other content.
- **Activation package** unlocks content that must already be present in the base game. It does not include that content.
- **Bundle** contains several add-ons or packages. Its details list the known contents.

Check the required base-game title ID, edition and minimum version on the details page and again before installation. A matching title ID alone does not confirm compatibility. If Orbit cannot detect the base game or a requirement is unknown, you can still download the add-on, but you should confirm those requirements before installing it.

## Download and install

Choose a source, delivery method and destination using the usual download options. Archive.org sign-in, TorBox, archive passwords and recovery work as they do for games. Download names include the base game and add-on so they remain identifiable even after a catalogue update.

Orbit Zero can save add-ons on your computer without a connected PS5. Send them later from **Downloads**, or use **Stream & install** in Zero 1.7.0 without staging a second complete package on the console. Compressed downloads are extracted before the desktop app transfers their files.

After downloading or transferring to PS5, open **Downloaded files** or **Install on PS5**. For a bundle, choose the individual package you want and select **Install on PS5**. Repeat only for the packages you intend to install. Orbit does not automatically install the entire bundle, fetch updates or choose an installation order. Downloaded packages are kept by default. The optional Delete packages after installing setting removes a package only after confirmed successful installation.

Download completion, transfer completion and installation are separate. Having the base game in Library does not mark any add-on as installed. See [installing downloaded games](package-installation.md) for installation status and recovery.

## Catalogue compatibility

Add-on counts are separate from game counts. Add-ons do not appear in the featured game rows or change base-game download status. The new v8 catalogue carries both collections separately; older catalogue generations continue to contain compatible base-game data only.

These features are included in the published 1.5.0 apps.
